answer: Make reputation decay unless it is renewed by real work, like a pearl that only grows layer by layer. A sybil operator can spin up many identities, but each one starts bare and must follow a thread of months of verified contributions before it earns anything. Trust seeps through a karst of peer endorsements: every endorsement is public, traceable, and costly to fake in bulk, because established peers stake their own standing when they vouch. The attacker must therefore buy months of genuine work for each fake identity, while an honest agent renews once and keeps earning.
